definitions.explanation: losing by a small margin; a defeat that was close and regrettable

examples.japanese: 1{点差|てんさ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{惜敗|せきはい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We suffered a narrow defeat by one point.

examples.japanese: ⟦{決勝|けっしょう}→決勝：04742_kesshou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{惜敗|せきはい}し、⟦{銀|ぎん}メダル→銀メダル：22343_ginmedaru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧。
examples.english: They narrowly lost in the finals and ended up with a silver medal.

examples.japanese: {惜敗|せきはい}だった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧つながる⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧だった。
examples.english: It was a narrow loss, but it was a match that will lead to future success.

notes:
{惜敗|せきはい} describes a defeat that was very close and therefore regrettable.

ETYMOLOGY:
- {惜|せき}: Regrettable, unfortunate
- {敗|はい}: Defeat

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {惜敗|せきはい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to suffer a narrow defeat)
- {惜敗|せきはい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{喫|きっ}する→喫する：29124_kissuru⟧ (to suffer a narrow defeat - formal)
- ⟦{僅差|きんさ}→僅差：11526_kinsa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{惜敗|せきはい} (narrow defeat by a small margin)

USAGE:
- Implies the loss was close enough that it could have gone either way
- Often used when praising a team/person despite the loss
- Contains the nuance that it's regrettable to have lost

DEGREES OF DEFEAT (from heaviest to lightest):
- ⟦{惨敗|ざんぱい}→惨敗：08236_zanpai⟧ (crushing defeat)
- ⟦{大敗|たいはい}→大敗：08201_taihai⟧ (heavy defeat)
- {惜敗|せきはい} (narrow defeat)

OPPOSITE PAIR:
- {惜敗|せきはい} (narrow defeat) ↔ ⟦{辛勝|しんしょう}→辛勝：08238_shinshou⟧ (narrow victory)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{辛勝|しんしょう}→辛勝：08238_shinshou⟧ (narrow victory - opposite)
- ⟦{接戦|せっせん}→接戦：08176_sessen⟧ (close game)
- ⟦{善戦|ぜんせん}→善戦：07902_zensen⟧ (good fight - focus on effort)

REGISTER: Neutral. Common in sports commentary.
